description: The National Statistics Office of Mongolia publishes census based housing and infrastructure tables in its PxWeb database, which has an open JSON API. The folder Infrastructure, housing holds nine tables. The most detailed go down to the 367 soums and districts: households by electricity source (central power system, diesel plant, renewable energy system, small generator or none), by water supply type (central or individual system, piped water kiosk, protected well or spring, bottled water, tanker truck, or river, lake and unprotected sources), the share with sanitation access, and households living in a ger, a house or other dwelling. Other tables give apartment households with central or independent engineering systems, and occupied housing by wall material. Coverage is national: for the year labelled 2020 the API returned 897,427 households, of which 732,494 were on the central power system and 151,999 used a renewable energy system; the table also has 2010 and 2025 columns. Format and access: free through the PxWeb API (JSON query, CSV or JSON output) and web interface, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the 2025 values are labelled as census years in the tables but their source was not checked; area names mix levels in one list. Simulation uses: soum level grid connection, off grid solar and water source for rural electrification and water supply planning, and ger districts for exposure and heating demand. Related records: the Kazakhstan census 2021 housing utilities and the Mongolia mobile coverage map.
